# physwrite

```text
usage: physwrite [-h] [--size SIZE] addr value

```

Write a value to a physical address by temporarily switching to physical mode.
### Positional arguments

|Positional Argument|Help|
| :--- | :--- |
|addr|Physical address to write to|
|value|Integer value to write|

### Optional arguments

|Short|Long|Help|
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
|-h|--help|show this help message and exit|
||--size|Number of bytes to write (default: 8) (default: 8)|
